capture.source: local ClickHouse public market history; committed realtime batches only

scope: minute boundaries only; held quotes retained with exact source age; no delta replay; public BBO and minimum order quantity; no mark/mid
fees: Standard taker 0.00035 future; min(0.0003*index, 0.125*premium) linear option or min(0.0003, 0.125*premium) coin option. Delivery/financing/account margin not deducted: all net results are optimistic.
